head: Google Maps motorcycle mode spotted on Android Auto for some riders
dek: Some riders report a motorcycle option in Google Maps on Android Auto that suggests narrow roads and shortcuts for two-wheelers and avoids expressways, according to Android Authority and Android Police. Google hasn't announced it, and it may be a test.
details: A Reddit user in the r/indianbikes group saw it while running Android Auto on an old phone with the Open Headunit app, after Maps offered to switch to two-wheeler directions; a motorbike icon then showed in the directions screen. A few other users said they have it too, and one said it shows in newer Open Headunit builds. No country, app version or rollout date has been given.
where: Seen by a few Android Auto users, including through the Open Headunit app; not announced
means: If you ride a motorcycle or scooter with Android Auto, Maps may soon give you routes made for two wheels instead of car routes.
todo: Nothing to do; if the motorbike icon shows in your Maps directions on Android Auto, you can try it.
